notes.title: Our new game - Inn Trouble - is now released!
notes.notes:
If you're ready to look at furnishing from a different angle – specifically, from the perspective of optimization and upgrades – then you might enjoy our new game about furnishing a fairytale inn. It doesn't offer the same freedom of furniture placement, but everything you install is actually used by the fairytale characters. We worked really hard to make this new game cozy and funny. We hope those of you who love idlers will enjoy it too!

P.S. For owners of our current game – Inn Trouble is already included in a bundle, so you should have an additional discount! :)

notes.title: Inn Trouble Demo is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We're excited to announce that the demo for our new game, Inn Trouble, is now available! Head over to the game page for all the details. If you're having fun, don't forget to add us to your wishlist! Happy gaming!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3197810/Inn_Trouble/

notes.title: Pixel Mode - Now Available in the Game!
notes.notes:
We know that there are players for whom a truly cozy game is impossible without charming pixels. If you are one of them, you can enable "Pixel Mode" in the game settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44933327/3362de5476a5469b5d9c531a951d854071e7ede3.png[/img]
Enjoy your game!

notes.title: Developer Update: What's on Our Workbench?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We have two pieces of news to share.

The first news is shrouded in mystery. We are working on a big game that’s far more ambitious than anything we’ve done before. We'd love to share more details, but it’s still too early. What’s important is that if you’re reading this, you’ll likely enjoy it :)

The second news is more niche. Over the past few months, we’ve created a small experimental game about fashion that we really like. It was initially quite experimental and ended up being so specialized that it appeals mainly to fans of fashion and the beloved roguelike genre. If you find yourself in this unique intersection, you might enjoy "The Great Couturier." And if you do, please leave a review on its page – it will help other fans of this (nonexistent?) genre discover the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850970/The_Great_Couturier/

That’s all for now. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Game Now Available in Six New Languages!
notes.notes:
The game is now available in six new languages: Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Russian, and French. By default, the game will be downloaded in the language of your Steam client. You can also switch to your preferred language manually - find the game in your library, right-click on it, select Properties - Language - and then your desired language.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: “Fairytale Furnishing” is now available!
notes.notes: For those who delight in decorating enchanting cottages, the time has come to dive into a fairytale. You can choose to play without delving into the narrative, simply furnishing homes at each level. Or, you can read the messages at the end of the levels to become more acquainted with the storyline. Warning: the messages contain a generous dose of sarcasm and dark humor. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Game Launching in One Week - May 17th!
notes.notes: We are thrilled to announce that our game is nearly complete and will be available for you to try on May 17th. We look forward to welcoming you to our small, yet (we hope) enchanting game, which offers you the unique opportunity to delve into interior design within a magical setting. We eagerly await your feedback!
